conditions: Navigate to a product detail page (e.g. /product/1)
items.expected: Page displays the product name, price, description, and an Add to cart button

conditions: Click - button to decrease quantity back to 1
Click - button again when quantity is 1
items.expected: Quantity increases when + is clicked; quantity decreases when - is clicked; quantity never goes below 1
A related products section is visible listing other products; clicking one navigates to that product's own detail page

conditions: Navigate to a product detail page
Run axe-core accessibility scan on the product detail area
items.expected: No accessibility violations reported by axe-core for WCAG A/AA rules

excluded.reason: Active bug about admin product search not narrowing the list — this is an admin-side feature, not the shopper product detail page that TOOL-11 covers.
Active bug about billing address not being filled from customer profile — this is a checkout/billing concern, not the product detail page that TOOL-11 covers.
The product detail page is publicly accessible with no authentication or account-sensitive data; TOOL-11 implies no security requirements specific to this page.
Neither open bug (TOOL-21, TOOL-20) touches this story's behaviour; no confirmation tests are warranted here.
